explication: FreeLLMAPI aggregates free and custom LLM providers behind an OpenAI-compatible API, with a dashboard and CLI for managing and using the router. The main workflow is a client request entering the server, being routed against model availability, keys, quotas, and scoring, then dispatched to a provider. The README documents additional catalog, multimodal, compression, analytics, and desktop capabilities; source excerpts confirm selected wiring, while many route and service relationships are documented but not sampled.
